answer_sql:
SELECT
  s.store_name,
  s.square_metres AS actual_shop_size_m2,
  ROUND(AVG(s.square_metres) OVER (), 2) AS average_shop_size_m2,
  ROUND(s.square_metres * 1.0 / AVG(s.square_metres) OVER (), 4) AS size_ratio
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
WHERE
  s.is_online = FALSE AND s.close_date IS NULL
ORDER BY
  s.store_name
